svg.text: The head flashes: fourteen, each tied to a game moment
Brief pops at the head, in each fighter's own shapes. Each cell is the flash at its peak. At rest there is nothing.
Every flash in each shape family: circles (Protagonist), blades (Anti-hero), wedges (Empress), steps (Cyborg)
An ambush from hiding, a telegraphed heavy or beam, or an attack from off screen. A parry
window keeps the crown's ring, because a flash would double it. (Event: ambush, attack
A low dry tick with a short upward sweep. No chirp, no stinger.
The world is about to hit the fighter: a falling building, a collapsing crater rim, a beam
path, rising water. Not a fighter attack (that is danger sense). (Event: hazard_telegraph
Leaving cover with the ambush window open (x1.5 damage for 2.5 s): the fighter can strike
hard now. It points forward, where danger sense points back. (Event: ambush_ready
(Encounter; the rule exists in the prototype).)
A hidden rival is found, or a lost lock-on is regained. (Event: found, lock regained.)
One bright rising note, in the fighter's own pitch.
Lock-on lost, hunting a hidden rival. It re-pops at most every 3 s while the search lasts.
An opponent starts a finisher, or the fighter watches a rival transform. (Event:
finisher_start against the fighter, cinematic_start of the rival.)
A shiver: a quick tremolo on a held breath.
Drop the Act, a wrath spike, a boil-over, a humiliating parry. (Event: drop_act,
A growl that swells and cuts off.
A heavy hit or a break launch, when the crown is not up. (Event: damage kind heavy,
A Rally or Second Wind: the fighter gathers itself. It fires just after the crown's wear pop
fades, and it is never dropped by arbitration. (Event: rally.)
A breath in, then a low held note.
A finisher lands, or a KO for the winner. (Event: ko (winner), finisher landed.)
A bright chime with the fighter's laugh.
After a decisive exchange won, before the next one. The Anti-hero's front. (Event: decisive
A slow exhale and a held soft chord.
A clash ends in a draw, a finisher is blocked, or a rival gets back up after a heavy hit:
the fighter acknowledges the other. (Event: clash_draw, finisher_blocked, rally of the
A taunt line or gesture. (Event: taunt bark.)
The fighter's sneer or dry laugh.
A transformation: held for the respected cinematic (up to 3 s), then it fades in 1.2 s. The
one flash that lasts. (Event: cinematic_start and cinematic_end.)
A rising swell that resolves on the new form's chord.

Shape rules: circles use round-ended bars, dots and arcs; blades use tapered blades and diamonds; wedges use wedge triangles; steps use squares snapped to a grid. Info flashes (danger, found, searching) are solid, at
full opacity, with a dark keyline in the lane colour. Emotion flashes are translucent, with a rim and a lighter core. Priority 1 wins.
